title: kbarticlecomment
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, kbarticleid, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby.

commenttext.description: Comment text for the knowledge base article.

createdon.description: Date and time when the knowledge base article comment was created.

kbarticlecommentid.description: Unique identifier of the knowledge base article comment.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the knowledge base article comment was last modified.

organizationid.description: Unique identifier of the organization with which the article comment is associated.

title.description: Title of the knowledge base article comment.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the knowledge base article comment.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the kbarticlecomment.

_kbarticleid_value.description: Unique identifier of the knowledge base article to which the comment applies.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the knowledge base article comment.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the kbarticlecomment.
